messages:
emma (People Ops): Quick heads-up: mandatory annual privacy & SOC2 attestation is open. We need evidence owners to attach one small artifact (screenshot/config/file) by EOD next Wednesday. Please see the 2-min 'Take5' checklist below and the new evidence tagging convention.
emma (People Ops): Take5 checklist: 1) confirm owner, 2) attach artifact to the Evidence Portal, 3) add tag format TAG:team-name, 4) mark 'submitted' in the tracker. Link: https://intra.redwood/evidence-portal
raj (Security): 🚨 New: for infra configs include the file header with a sha256 hash. Minimal ask — just a copy of the running config or a screenshot of the dashboard with date visible.
olivia (Eng): quick Q — if model eval logs are stored in S3, is a link + S3 path enough or do we need to snapshot?
zoe (Legal): Link + path is fine if the S3 object has restricted access and retention proof. If it's public, we need a snapshot. ping me if unsure.
liam (Platform): Adding: for Dedicated infra owners, please also note the cluster id and the commit SHA in the evidence comment. Example: cluster=ded-nyc-3 commit=ab12cd3
emma (People Ops): Office hours this Thurs 11:00–12:00 PST in #help — quick 15-min drop-ins for people who want runthroughs. Also we'll auto-remind team leads tomorrow morning.
compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: Evidence deadline in 3 days. Action: 1 outstanding per-eng-team. View: https://intra.redwood/compliance-dashboard
olivia (Eng): Done — uploaded eval logs + S3 path, added TAG:eng-runtime
raj (Security): Verified: has timestamp and token gating. Marked as acceptable.
liam (Platform): FYI we found one cluster that had an expired cert; raised a ticket and attached rotated cert to evidence.
zoe (Legal): thanks everyone — if you need an exception for scope (e.g., third-party managed service), submit via the exception form and include the vendor contract snippet.
emma (People Ops): Thanks! If you haven't started, please prioritize this — compliance team will begin sampling next week and we want to keep it low-effort for everyone. :thumbsup:
